title: Quad SPI slave: standard mode (MOSI on io[0], MISO on io[1]) and quad mode (a nibble per SCLK on io[3:0], read or write)

words.name: TX
words.desc: Byte shifted out (MISO in standard mode, io[3:0] in a quad read)

words.name: DIR
words.desc: Bit 0, quad mode: 0 the slave drives io[3:0] (read), 1 it releases them (write) (write-only)

irqs.name: BYTE
irqs.desc: a byte was received (eight standard or two quad SCLK rising edges)

notes: sclk, csn and io are the QSPI pins; they pass through unchanged. SCLK is sampled on clk: it must stay high and low at least two clocks each.
